name: Montclar (Spain)
description: Dark green field with two white pales and, at the centre, the white Latin cross patée of the arms.
history: The original flag, approved on 9 June 2006 (DOGC no. 4666 of 30 June 2006), was a horizontal bicolour of red and dark green with the white cross; on 7 February 2007 the council opened a file to modify it, and the current flag was approved on 7 February 2009 and published in the DOGC no. 5577 of 1 March 2009: an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the white Latin cross patée of the arms and two white pales.

features.role: two pales each 1/24 of the length
Latin cross patée of the arms, 5/6 of the height
